description: Write. Pauses a link: until it is resumed, every tap gets the "link not found" page instead of the app, store or website. Its history stays in analytics. Needs confirm: true; without it nothing changes and you get a preview of the link to show the user. Undo with resume_link.

confirm.description: true to pause; omit or false to preview

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

name: pause_link
title: Pause a link
